name: Times cryptic crossword, Times Crosswords book 1 No 119

clue.text: Note — this is about to tease people
Go underground, unable to settle down
In other words, editor finalises sharper version
Disgust dissenter, having change of heart
Firm beset by a French delay oddly showing no anxiety
Last act of Endgame, coming very soon for 23
In real trouble, having to swallow bread and cheese
given less than hour, coming in late
A small case of being quite silly, no question
and 23 meet to see The French Connection
Bird, in practice, following duck to lake
See source of cackling and smile — A Knight at the Opera 2. Plan to surprise carol singers, after extra rest (3.2.4) Final translation of 21 — first of it appearing today
Inquisitor turning force on first man brought up
One mischievous and playful, primarily
23°s task in Mission Impossible?
Someone from over the border in Scotland
Staff joined by popular French master
Wonderful place to live, but on shaky foundations for 23
Role of Othello reviewed by proxy as a hit
Top award — falsely glittering for 23
Clever, keeping in also previous PC facility (3.3.5) Bill has grasped nothing, climbing into danger with slopes all around
Restrictions put on latest type of ammunition (5.4) Some hate filling boxes with text
Served up a popular lunch, perhaps fillet
Cold dish incomplete — put in second spicy sauce
Cod — the fish provided by 21
Play the game, finally wiser!
